comment: Part of the per-platform migration of the child corporate-owned enrollment restriction.
See child-enrollment-restriction-android.json for the migration background.
Windows corporate-owned devices (Autopilot) only; personal-device enrollment stays blocked.
NOTE: the old single-policy schema also had a distinct 'windowsHomeSkuRestriction' field
blocking Windows Home SKU specifically. The new per-platform Graph model has no equivalent
platformType for that (enum is: allPlatforms, ios, windows, windowsPhone, android,
androidForWork, mac, linux) so that specific SKU-level block could not be migrated 1:1 and
was deliberately dropped rather than guessed at. Windows devices are still gated by this
policy's minimum OS version and personal-device block.
name: child-enrollment-restriction-windows
